147-653-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-5686.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-6965-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-6965-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

4091-5983-7791.description:
Activate Snapping Voidcraw by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Snapping Voidcraw.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Snapping Voidcraw.
Repeat.

2511-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2511-4302-5929.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-6798-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1946-2034-3169-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Nomads en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1661-2757-3459-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

967-997-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1129-1978-2750.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1978-2750.description:
Cause Harabaz Druid to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

985-2854-3518-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
985-2854-3518-4574.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

6196-6832.description: Because Spy Kit gives the creature the name of every nonlegendary creature card, no nonlegendary creature spells can be cast.

2034-2043-3910-5346.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Breya that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the token Breya into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Breya's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, adding {R}{R} and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3372-4785-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4785-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

478-2821-3573-3918.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four artifacts.
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3573-3918.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

185-4293-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U}, returning Runic Repetition to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {2}{U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

985-2510-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1506-2942-3059.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Malignus.
Malignus does not have summoning sickness.
1506-2942-3059.description:
Activate Malignus by tapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to three times its power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

3244-4814.notablePrerequisites:
"Phyrexian" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
There are at least fifteen artifact cards in library.
You have at least one card in your graveyard.
3244-4814.description:
Cast Morality Shift by pying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
At the beginning of your end step, Mirrodin Besieged triggers, causing you to loot, and then causing target opponent to lose the game.

240-643-3082-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting that card onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing that creature.
Repeat from step 4 until Triumph of Saint Katherine is on the battlefield again.
Repeat from step 1.

248-3362-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
248-3362-4050.description:
Cast Bladewing either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Bladewing enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing Bladewing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Changeling Berserker, adding one mana of any color.
Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

364-813-1987-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
